claim: An artist has said he is taking legal advice after accusing the Conservative Party of copying his portrait of Andy Burnham at their party conference.
label: TRUE
annotatorNote: [AI label: Claude, 2026-10-05 - not yet checked by the human annotator] The Independent (via Yahoo) and Resonate, both 5 Oct 2026: Manchester illustrator Stanley Chow said on Instagram that the Conservatives had used his Burnham artwork without permission at their Birmingham conference and that he would be 'seeking legal advice'. A Conservative source called it 'nonsense' (drawn by their own designers); the claim is only that he accused them, which holds.
